questions.question: According to the proverb, what do the rich and the poor have in common?

answers.text: The LORD is Maker of them all
Toil is the lot of them all

questions.question: According to the proverb, which two things bring wealth and honor and life?

answers.text: Humility and the fear of the LORD
Sacrifice and the altar of the LORD
Courage and the favor of the king

questions.question: True or false: a child trained in the way he should go will leave that way when he is old.
Why does the proverb say a generous man will be blessed?

answers.text: He shares his bread with the poor
He gives fine gifts to the king
He lends money to his neighbors
